cr2bf_blurb: Funds deployed across 30+ energy-efficiency and clean-heat programs, energy savings achieved, participants served, and where installations occurred. Tables A1–A10.
Capital incentives and the resulting Level-2 and DC fast-charging plug counts. Tables B1–B2.
Five demand-response programs with participation, committed load, and delivered load by DAC and low-income segments. Tables C1–C5.
Distributed Energy Resources interconnected to the grid: project counts, MW installed, DAC share. Tables D1–D4.
Electric capital investment by category and the share whose benefits affect DAC areas. Table E1.
System reliability: outage counts, customer interruptions, network vs non-network, DAC vs non-DAC. Tables F1–F9.
Leak-prone gas main retired, replaced, and abandoned by county, plus CH4 emissions reductions. Tables G1–G10.
Gas leak repairs by borough/county, DAC vs non-DAC. Table H1.
Clean Energy Academy enrollment, graduation, and job placements. Table I1.
Customer-operations equity: usage, unpaid accounts, disconnections, EAP, total customers. Tables J1–J9. Several J tables cover only Apr–Dec 2023.
